fresh_identity_statement: I am the independent assigned reader for this exact task. I personally read the full 50 assigned authored snapshots, actual rendered example code and 47 CPU output blocks, and personally viewed every one of the 13 unique assigned teaching-figure renders. I did not consult earlier estimates, author or peer verdicts, and did not delegate reading or judgments.
audience: Mathematically prepared high-school or basic-university novice to these topics.
estimate_scope: Reading authored body, teaching figures, example code and actual visible CPU outputs, plus brief concept checks and exercise predictions. Installation/download time, editing or executing exercises, training/waits and extra prerequisite reading are excluded; displayed commands are read as text. These are AI estimates, not measured human averages.
method: Own positive-integer interval for each page, chosen manually from the specific learning and comparison work after complete personal reading. No word/line formula, elapsed-tool-time proxy, old-minute reuse or hash-only inheritance.
read_order_semantics: Canonical IDs record first full authored-snapshot reading order. Actual CPU-output, figure and later rendered-code passes are separately recorded in receipts/reading-events.json; all these passes completed before manual estimates were written.
